title: Paul's Journeys Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Paul’s Journeys Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Paul's missionary journeys Bible crossword: Cyprus, Philippi, Athens and Mars' hill, Ephesus and Rome. Free KJV puzzles on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Three journeys and a voyage in chains, across most of the eastern Mediterranean. Paul's Journeys follows the route — Cyprus with Barnabas, the vision of the man of Macedonia, the jail at Philippi that shook at midnight, Mars' hill and the altar to the unknown God, two years in Ephesus, and at last Rome.
The geography is the puzzle here, and it is genuinely hard: the clues expect the cities and who was met in them. The closing verse is the commission that sets the whole book in motion.
